verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test mode is a fair question for an agent tool gateway that proxies real provider calls. However, the evidence documents only live proxying to real upstream endpoints and never mentions a sandbox, test mode, mock responses or dry-run. One community user self-hosts treg for development, but that is a user-side arrangement, not a product-provided sandbox isolated from production data, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
